description: This bar chart visual empowers data analysts to explore the distribution of categorical data by displaying both the mean and standard deviation of numeric values for each category. To use this visual, simply upload a dataset with two columns: one numeric and one categorical. The chart will then generate a colorful, customizable display that clearly highlights variances and central tendencies across categories. This visual is completely free to use. No licenses, subscriptions, or additional charges are required to access any features.
